IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Sunday 15 November
Winds: Southwesterly 15 to 25 knots increasing to 20 to 30 knots in the late afternoon then decreasing to 15 to 25 knots in the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres around midday, then increasing to 1.5 to 2 metres during the afternoon.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 70% chance of showers, with possible small hail in the afternoon and evening.

Monday 16 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots becoming northwesterly below 10 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Tuesday 17 November
Winds: Northwesterly below 10 knots tending westerly 10 to 15 knots during the morning then tending southwesterly during the day.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Wednesday 18 November
Winds: West to southwesterly about 10 knots tending southeasterly 10 to 15 knots during the day then decreasing to below 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloud clearing.
warnings: Strong Wind Warning for Sunday for Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.synoptic: A cold front crosses the state today shifting the flow southwesterly. A series of troughs in that southwesterly flow are expected to cross the south of Tasmania on Monday and Tuesday before a high pressure system establishes over Tasmania bringing settled conditions into the mid week.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Sunday 15 November
Winds: Southwesterly 15 to 25 knots, reaching up to 30 knots in the late morning and afternoon.
Seas: 2 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres inshore, increasing to 3 to 4 metres offshore.
Weather: Cloudy. 60% chance of showers, with possible small hail.

Monday 16 November
Winds: Southwesterly 15 to 20 knots turning westerly 20 to 30 knots before dawn.
Seas: 1.5 to 2 metres, increasing to 2 to 3 metres during the morning.
Swell: Southwesterly 3 to 4 metres.
Weather: Cloudy. 50% chance of showers.

Tuesday 17 November
Winds: Westerly 20 to 30 knots turning southwesterly during the day.
Seas: 2 to 3 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres inshore, increasing to 3 to 4 metres offshore.
Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers.
warnings: Strong Wind Warning for Monday for South East Coast
